nodes.description: Immutable owner address of FlapperMassBid, set in constructor and used as the only authorized caller.
VowAbstract immutable reference to the Maker Vow, used to fetch bump() and flapper().
FlapAbstract immutable reference to the surplus auction (flapper) contract, used for beg(), bids() and tend().
DaiJoinAbstract immutable reference used to exit DAI from the vat.
DaiAbstract immutable reference to the DAI ERC-20 token.
VatAbstract immutable reference to the Maker vat, used to read internal DAI balance and hope daiJoin.
DSTokenAbstract immutable reference to the MKR token used for bidding.
Constant WAD = 10**18 used for fixed point bid comparisons.
Constant RAY = 10**27 used to convert internal vat DAI to external DAI.
Constructor wiring immutable addresses and granting MKR approval to flap and vat hope to daiJoin.
View function filtering active flap auctions and encoding a bid payload for execute.
Owner-only function decoding auction data, pulling MKR and calling flap.tend on each auction.
Owner-only function exiting internal vat DAI into the owner's wallet.
Owner-only function transferring any residual MKR out of the contract.
Owner-only function transferring any residual DAI out of the contract.
Factory constructor storing the shared vow and daiJoin addresses.
Factory function deploying a new FlapperMassBid owned by msg.sender.
Immutable vow address stored by the factory and passed to new FlapperMassBid instances.
Immutable daiJoin address stored by the factory and passed to new FlapperMassBid instances.
Caller address, checked against owner for privileged functions and used as new bid owner in create.
Current block timestamp compared against auction tic and end values in findAuctions.
External MKR transferFrom pulling the bid amount from owner into the contract.
External call to the flapper tend() inside a try/catch loop, a potential reentrancy vector.
External call exiting DAI from the vat to the owner.
External MKR transfer sending residual or outbid MKR back to the owner.
External DAI transfer sending residual DAI to the owner.
Arithmetic multiplication used in balance and allowance checks.
Arithmetic multiplication of bid amount by the number of auctions to size the MKR transferFrom.
Arithmetic division converting internal vat DAI (RAY) to external DAI (WAD).
Contract creation performed by the factory in create().
Parameter giving the first auction index to scan in findAuctions.
Parameter giving the last auction index to scan in findAuctions.
Parameter bounding the number of auctions selected in findAuctions.
Parameter giving the MKR bid amount in WAD per auction.
Encoded payload parameter decoded by execute into bid and auctions.

Constructor parameter setting the vow reference.
Constructor parameter setting the daiJoin reference.

Factory constructor parameter setting the shared daiJoin.

Loop index iterating over auction indices in findAuctions.
Memory array of AuctionCandidate selected in findAuctions.
Count of selected candidate auctions to bid on.
Local tracking the largest-bid candidate to be replaced when the candidate list is full.
Decoded bid amount applied to every selected auction in execute.
Decoded array of auction indices to bid on in execute.
Local holding vow.bump() lot amount passed to flap.tend.
Auction bidder address read from flap.bids(i); zero means the auction does not exist.
Auction expiry timestamp read from flap.bids(i), compared to block.timestamp.

edges.reason: execute requires msg.sender == owner, so the owner state variable gates execution.
extractVatDAI requires msg.sender == owner.
extractMKR requires msg.sender == owner.
extractDAI requires msg.sender == owner.
findAuctions checks MKR balanceOf and allowance of the owner.
execute reads the lot amount via vow.bump().
constructor queries vow.flapper() to derive the flap address.
findAuctions reads flap.beg() and flap.bids(i).
constructor queries flap.gem() to derive the MKR address.
findAuctions queries mkr.balanceOf and mkr.allowance.
execute uses mkr.transferFrom and mkr.transfer.
constructor grants mkr.approve to the flap contract.
constructor derives dai and vat from daiJoin.dai() and daiJoin.vat().
extractDAI reads dai.balanceOf and calls dai.transfer.
extractVatDAI reads vat.dai(address(this)).
WAD scales the bid comparison mkrBidInWads * WAD < beg * bid.
RAY is used to convert internal vat DAI to external DAI in the division.
constructor assigns owner = _owner.
constructor assigns vow = VowAbstract(_vow).
create passes the factory vow into the new FlapperMassBid.
create passes the factory daiJoin into the new FlapperMassBid.
execute authorization depends on msg.sender matching owner.
extractVatDAI authorization depends on msg.sender matching owner.
extractMKR authorization depends on msg.sender matching owner.
extractDAI authorization depends on msg.sender matching owner.
create deploys a new FlapperMassBid owned by msg.sender.
findAuctions results depend on block.timestamp comparisons for auction validity.
tic is compared with block.timestamp to skip finished auctions.
end is compared with block.timestamp to skip ended auctions.
startAuctionIndex seeds the auction scanning loop.
endAuctionIndex bounds the auction scanning loop.
maxAuctionsToBid sizes the candidates array and bounds selection.
mkrBidInWads is compared against each auction bid.
execute abi-decodes data into bid and auctions.
_owner parameter becomes the immutable owner.
_vow parameter becomes the immutable vow.
_daiJoin parameter becomes the immutable daiJoin.
factory _vow parameter is stored as factory vow.
factory _daiJoin parameter is stored as factory daiJoin.
beg is read from flap.beg() and used in the bid comparison.
i drives the auction scanning loop iterations.
candidates memory array accumulates the selected auctions.
numAuctions counts selected candidates and sizes the returned array.
largestBidCandidate determines which filled slot can be replaced.
decoded bid is multiplied by auctions.length to size the MKR pull.
decoded auctions array length participates in the MKR amount multiplication.
lot is passed as the lot argument to flap.tend.
guy is used to skip non-existent auctions.
tic is used to skip auctions that have finished.
end is used to skip auctions past their end time.
o drives the inner loop searching for the largest bid candidate.
candidate is inspected while scanning for the largest bid.
findAuctions multiplies mkrBidInWads by maxAuctionsToBid for balance/allowance checks.
execute calls mkr.transferFrom to pull the bidding MKR from the owner.
execute performs external flap.tend calls inside a try/catch loop.
execute performs an external mkr.transfer of any remaining balance.
execute computes bid * auctions.length as the MKR transfer amount.
extractVatDAI calls the external daiJoin.exit.
extractVatDAI divides vat.dai by RAY.
extractMKR performs an external mkr.transfer to the owner.
extractDAI performs an external dai.transfer to the owner.
create performs contract creation of a new FlapperMassBid.
the external flapper contract invoked via flap.tend could call back into execute before completion.
the external daiJoin invoked via exit returns control to the contract and could call back.

normalization_plan.reason: startAuctionIndex is only used inside findAuctions.
endAuctionIndex is only used inside findAuctions.
maxAuctionsToBid is only used inside findAuctions.
mkrBidInWads is only used inside findAuctions.
data is decoded and only used inside execute.
_owner is only used in the FlapperMassBid constructor.
_vow is only used in the FlapperMassBid constructor.
_daiJoin is only used in the FlapperMassBid constructor.
factory _vow is only used in the factory constructor.
factory _daiJoin is only used in the factory constructor.
beg is a local computed and consumed within findAuctions.
i is the loop index local to findAuctions.
candidates is a memory array local to findAuctions.
numAuctions is a counter local to findAuctions.
largestBidCandidate is a scratch local within findAuctions.
bid flows directly into the bid * auctions.length arithmetic in execute.
auctions length flows directly into the arithmetic sizing the MKR pull.
lot is passed directly into the external flap.tend call.
guy is a local read from flap.bids within findAuctions.
tic is a local timestamp value consumed within findAuctions.
end is a local timestamp value consumed within findAuctions.
o is the inner loop index local to findAuctions.
candidate is a temporary local within the findAuctions selection loop.
